content.body:
BASIC INFORMATION
/HC: Displays online HC members and OICs, as well as their brigade assignments and rank. /HCLIST: Displays the names of all HC members online, including OICs. /HELP: Displays list of all text commands available to a player. (Also /H). /HELP (COMMAND): Provides limited in-game assistance with text commands /HOME: Reports the prestige "home" of your brigade - not its actual location. /LISTOICS: Displays a list of current OIC assignments. /NOWHO: Hides/unhides you from /who functions. /REPORT (TEXT): Sends a report to GMs online and CRS via email. For use when suspected Cheating, Griefing, or terrain anomolies are found. We do not respond to reports, but read and monitor them. Bug reports should be posted in the Testing & Bug Reporting Forum. /SYSMOTD: View the system message of the day. /TIME: Displays local and game server time. /TRAINERS: List any trainers currently available. /WHO: Provides a list of online squad members. /WHO (PLAYER): Displays the Persona, Nearest Town, Rank and Brigade of the named player. Players who are not on the same side or are hidden with /NOWHO will appear to be offline. /WTF: Random messages that generally lead one to say "wtf?".
AIRCRAFT
/CONV (METERS): Sets the Convergance distance of your aircraft's guns.
content.title: Basic Commands
